chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning vs Four Celestial Immortals: Trapped by the Shaoyin Clan in Desperate Siege
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning is forced to his limits as four Celestial Immortals of the Shaoyin clan surround him. A battle of tactics, raw power, and the legendary Eight-Nine Arcane Art. Can he survive?
og_title: Ji Ning Faces a Four-Celestial Immortal Siege
og_description: The Shaoyin clan springs their trap. Ji Ning’s Primaltwin is forced to retreat, and he falls back on the legendary Eight-Nine Arcane Art to survive an onslaught of pure Yang-ranked treasures and frozen guillotines.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs 4 Celestial Immortals: A Desperate Last Stand
twitter_description: The Shaoyin clan’s ambush reaches its peak. Ji Ning uses the Eight-Nine Arcane Art’s body-splitting trick to escape, but at a terrible cost. A must-read tactical battle in Desolate Era.

lore_anchors.definition: The paramount Fiendgod Body Refining divine ability, granting supreme physical resilience and unique techniques like body-splitting, where the user can instantly divide their form into two, sacrificing one to recover power.
A treasure of the highest tier wielded by Celestial Immortals in the Three Realms, possessing immense, world-shaking power and often serving as a clan's heirloom.
A rare, one-use talisman that allows a cultivator to spontaneously teleport vast distances, escaping spatial locks and deadly formations.
A second, independently acting body cultivated by a Ki Refiner at the Primal Daoist stage, sharing the same soul and consciousness. In this chapter, it is forced to retreat.
A powerful, Immortal-ranked puppet known for its flight capabilities, controlled by a cultivator's divine sense. Here, it is piloted by Mu Northson.
Ji Ning's signature sword formation technique, arranged in a matrix of flying swords to form a devastating attack and defense pattern.
A grand divine ability that grants the user incredible speed and agility, allowing them to move like an untouchable breeze through a battlefield.
A top-tier divine ability created by Daofather Threelives, transforming the user's hands into weapons of immense, star-crushing power.
